sections.title: Nintendo Gallery
sections.note: Show Carlov a colour pictograph (Deluxe Picto Box) of each subject. On the GameCube he carves one figurine a day; in Wind Waker HD up to twelve.

items.name: Knuckle
items.howTo: Photograph Knuckle: Outset Island, Tingle Island.
items.notes: Missable: get it before every other figurine is done, as Carlov leaves once the gallery is complete. On the GameCube Knuckle is found with the Tingle Tuner (Game Boy Advance link) on Outset Island; in Wind Waker HD he appears on Tingle Island once all five Tingle Statues are found. Not needed for Link & the King of Red Lions.

items.notes: Carlov's last figurine. Missing any missable figurine (other than Knuckle) makes it unobtainable until a Second Quest, which keeps your figurines.
